title: Ocean Breeze Granny Square (Free Stashbuster Pattern + Printable)
author: Louise Bollanos (Handy Little Me)
notes: start: original "Foundation Ring: Using Yarn A, ch 4 and join with a sl-st to form a ring." replaced by magic ring. Round headings joined onto the first line. Optional Round 6 omitted. Round 2 says "ch 7 (counts as 1 dc and ch 3)" but the corners are ch 4; DSL uses ch 3 (dc) + ch 4. Stated "(4 groups of N dc ...)" counts are not machine-parsed; DSL totals agree (28, 44, 60, 76 dc).
